rule: Before writing artifact X, AI-DLC resolves aidlc/spaces/<space>/memory/templates/X.md first. A resolved template is used whole-doc: its ## headings are the skeleton, and the required-sections sensor checks the output against the same file.
selection: Only artifacts whose stage rule lists their sections are templated. Artifacts with machine-checked blocks (component catalogue, Unit edge block, entity and rule YAML, contract specs, traceability.json), question files, and artifacts whose rule names no sections are left to the stage rules. Conditional sections are left out so they are not made mandatory.

templates.title: Intent Statement
templates.ruleText: Create intent-statement.md containing: Problem Statement, Target Customer, Success Metrics, Initiative Trigger, Initial Scope Signal. Each artifact MUST contain ## Assumptions & Open Questions.

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.note: What business problem is being solved

sections.heading: Initial Scope Signal
sections.note: Show the workflow-selected scope separately from the user-confirmed product boundary

sections.heading: Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.note: Write None. when there are none

templates.title: Stakeholder Map
templates.ruleText: Create stakeholder-map.md containing: key stakeholders and their interests; decision-makers vs. influencers; communication requirements. Each artifact MUST contain ## Assumptions & Open Questions.

sections.heading: Key Stakeholders and Interests
sections.note: Key stakeholders and their interests; each row carries its source tag in a Source column

sections.heading: Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.note: Write None. when there are none

templates.title: Feasibility Assessment
templates.ruleText: Create feasibility assessment (technical viability, risk analysis)

templates.title: Constraint Register
templates.ruleText: constraint register (technical, organizational, regulatory)

templates.title: RAID Log
templates.ruleText: RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies)

templates.title: Scope Document
templates.ruleText: Create scope definition document (in/out boundary)

templates.title: Initiative Brief
templates.ruleText: Create initiative-brief.md — a one-pager combining: intent and problem statement; market validation summary; feasibility and risk highlights; scope boundary; concept visuals; team plan; go/no-go recommendation.

templates.title: Requirements
templates.ruleText: Create requirements.md containing: intent analysis; functional requirements (FR{n}); non-functional requirements (NFR{n}); constraints; assumptions; out of scope; open questions. Must not contain a ## Review section.

sections.heading: Intent Analysis
sections.note: What the user is trying to achieve (goals, not just features)

sections.heading: Functional Requirements
sections.note: Organized by feature area or domain; stable FR{n} IDs, sub-requirements FR{n}.{m}

sections.heading: Non-Functional Requirements
sections.note: Performance, security, scalability, reliability and observability targets; stable NFR{n} IDs

sections.heading: Open Questions
sections.note: Any remaining uncertainties for later stages

templates.title: Personas
templates.ruleText: personas.md: user persona definitions (name, role, goals, pain points, context); persona relationships and priority ranking

sections.heading: Persona Definitions
sections.note: Name, role, goals, pain points, context

templates.title: Performance Requirements
templates.ruleText: performance-requirements.md: Response time targets, throughput requirements, latency budgets, resource constraints, benchmarks. Every requirement carries an NFR{n}.{m} ID.

templates.title: Security Requirements
templates.ruleText: security-requirements.md: Authentication requirements, authorization model, data protection, compliance, threat considerations.

templates.title: Scalability Requirements
templates.ruleText: scalability-requirements.md: Load projections, scaling triggers, capacity planning, data growth, concurrency targets.

templates.title: Reliability Requirements
templates.ruleText: reliability-requirements.md: Availability targets (SLA/SLO), fault tolerance requirements, backup/recovery, graceful degradation.

templates.title: Observability Requirements
templates.ruleText: observability-requirements.md: Monitoring requirements, logging standards, distributed tracing needs, alerting thresholds, dashboard requirements, SLI/SLO definitions.

templates.title: Performance Design
templates.ruleText: performance-design.md: Caching architecture, optimization strategies, resource pooling, async patterns, performance budgets.

templates.title: Security Design
templates.ruleText: security-design.md: Authentication/authorization architecture, encryption design, input validation strategy, security headers, compliance controls.

templates.title: Scalability Design
templates.ruleText: scalability-design.md: Scaling architecture, load distribution, data partitioning strategy, capacity thresholds, auto-scaling rules.

templates.title: Reliability Design
templates.ruleText: reliability-design.md: Resilience patterns, circuit breaker configuration, retry policies, health check design, failover procedures, backup strategy.

templates.title: Observability Design
templates.ruleText: observability-design.md: Metrics collection architecture, structured logging design, distributed tracing strategy, alerting rules and escalation, dashboard specifications, SLI/SLO definitions, correlation ID propagation.

templates.title: Logical Components
templates.ruleText: logical-components.md: Logical infrastructure component inventory — service boundaries, failure domains, blast radius mapping, component isolation strategy, shared resource identification.

templates.title: Infrastructure Specification
templates.ruleText: infrastructure-specification.md: Deployment table, Infrastructure Services table, Shared Infrastructure table (CONDITIONAL — only when multiple units share resources; left out of this template so it is not required).

sections.heading: Deployment
sections.note: | Facet | Choice | Rationale | — compute model, networking topology, storage strategy, environments, IaC approach, resource sizing

templates.title: Monitoring Design
templates.ruleText: monitoring-design.md: Metrics & KPIs, Alerts, SLIs / SLOs, Logs & Tracing — tabular wherever possible.

sections.heading: Metrics & KPIs
sections.note: | Metric | Source | Threshold | Why it matters |

sections.heading: Logs & Tracing
sections.note: Log aggregation strategy, tracing configuration, dashboard specifications

templates.title: Build Instructions
templates.ruleText: build-instructions.md: dependency installation steps; environment setup; build commands; build verification steps; IaC static checks (conditional, left out of this template); troubleshooting common build issues.

sections.heading: Environment Setup
sections.note: Env vars, config files, local services

templates.title: Build and Test Summary
templates.ruleText: build-and-test-summary.md: overall build status and prerequisites; test type inventory; coverage expectations; a ## Target Verification Matrix; readiness assessment; known limitations or outstanding items.

sections.heading: Coverage Expectations
sections.note: For the project and each Unit

sections.heading: Target Verification Matrix
sections.note: One row per target: Target ID, Source, Expected, Actual, Evidence, Owning Stage, Verdict. Actual, Evidence and Verdict start as Pending.
